session_note: Arizona's 2026 regular session (57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session) adjourned sine die 2026-06-13. HB 4168 was enacted as 2026 Session Laws Chapter 140.

new_bills.status: Enacted as 2026 Session Laws Chapter 140; section 31 effective 2026-07-01
new_bills.key_provisions: Section 31 imposes a three-year moratorium, 2026-07-01 through 2029-06-30, on new applications to the state data center tax relief program under A.R.S. 41-1519. It suspends eligibility for the incentive; it does not pause data center construction, siting, or local permitting.
new_bills.notes: Surfaced by the Arizona month-by-month chronology sweep and initially proposed as an inventory row. Rejected from the inventory because it is a subsidy-eligibility freeze rather than a pause on development approval (see work/answers/rejected/README.md) and recorded here instead, where enacted state bills belong.

evidence.title: Arizona 2026 Session Laws, Chapter 140 (HB 4168)
evidence.supports: HB 4168 was enacted as Chapter 140 of the 2026 session laws, and its section 31 establishes a moratorium on new applications to the A.R.S. 41-1519 data center tax relief program from 2026-07-01 to 2029-06-30.
